statement:
**Hypothesis:**  
The game does **not** end when the last fila (wave) has been spawned; after the final fila the engine continues to run rounds (shoot → advance) until either all pirates are dead (win) or a pirate reaches position 3 (loss). Therefore a level where the last pirate is still alive after the final spawn can still be won in the subsequent rounds. => confirmed winnable by test level.
